name: Ramie Fathy, MD
title: Dermatology Resident, AI Researcher, Writer
summary: Dermatology resident at Johns Hopkins. I build clinical AI tools and study how they should — and shouldn't — be used at the bedside.

about.intro: Final-year dermatology resident at Johns Hopkins. Clinical interests: inflammatory and complex medical dermatology and dermatopathology. Research: clinical AI evaluation and tool development.
highlights: Incoming rheumatology-dermatology fellow at Mass General Brigham, joining Dr. Adam Rodman's research lab.
Princeton AB in Molecular Biology (Summa Cum Laude, Phi Beta Kappa); MD from Penn (AΩA).
